highlights.title: A second computer can be allowed
highlights.line: A computer you add to your Kosmos+ account now shows its request to be allowed on your first one, once that one has this update.

highlights.title: No typing behind unsent text
highlights.line: Kosmos no longer types behind unsent text in a Claude agent's box, and sends its own unsent line first with the next message.

highlights.title: Stop an account move
highlights.line: A move of several agents to another account can now be stopped; agents it had not reached keep their old account.

highlights.title: Kosmos waits while Claude asks you
highlights.line: While an agent shows a Claude prompt or question, Kosmos types nothing into it on its own; if you send, you are told to answer it there.

highlights.title: Long task and room messages arrive whole
highlights.line: A message from a colleague or a room now reaches an agent in one piece, unless it is longer than a chat message can be.
